The hospital capacity risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. The trial completed in 3m 46s, confirming that the core risk-calc logic is reusable for similar weighted-risk tasks. Future iterations should re-check edge case assumptions in the capacity thresholds to maintain the 0.81 judge_reward.
